assets.name: Rooftop row with chimneys
assets.description: far layer strip, 8 roofs. Cut black card (or the set's paper) with a consistent cut quality: clean scalpel edges, small deliberate nicks, no outlines, detail level "readable at 10% of frame height"; every piece declares its depth layer and its pivot points if hinged.
assets.purpose: Builds the city pieces so the stage has a believable world with 4-7 depth layers.
assets.references: Reiniger silhouette animation (Phase 1 B.24), cut-paper title design (B.1), stamp and colour-coded transitions (B.2), hinged cut-outs (B.23), silhouette-as-window (B.6). Method only: no piece copies a known film frame.
assets.format: SVG source (single filled path per part, no strokes) rasterised at build to an alpha mask atlas; JSON with depth layer, anchor, pivots and footprint.
assets.dimensions: Authored in a 2048-unit square artboard; masks exported at the size the piece occupies at its largest planned scale (512-2048 px wide).
assets.layer_structure: Alpha mask only (colour comes from the paper and light); optional second mask for cut-out holes (windows that let light through).
assets.animation: Static unless it carries pivots; moved by choreographies.
assets.colour_behaviour: Paper-driven: black card, or the set's tinted paper; lit from behind by the light rig.
assets.asset_compatibility: Other pieces of the same set; figures; frames; props of the same season.
assets.exclusion_rules: Never two sets in one stage (except the panorama, which joins neighbouring sets at a declared seam piece); no piece larger than 40% of the frame except near-frame pieces.
assets.responsive_behaviour: Pieces are placed by set compositions in normalised stage space; portrait compositions use the set's vertical arrangement and drop the widest pieces.
assets.performance: Alpha masks in a shared atlas per set (2048x2048 R8, about 4 MB); one atlas per active set.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Reads as cut paper (not vector clip-art); silhouette readable at 10% frame height; no recognisable real landmark or character; consistent edge quality with the family's approved first piece.
assets.variations_not_counted: Paper colour and light colour are parameters; mirrored use is allowed and not counted.

assets.name: Proscenium stage
assets.description: Focal point: The stage centre where the light is brightest. Lyric placement: Banner or card hung on strings in the upper-middle; cut letters in the light band at 40% height. Background: Backlit ground gradient; far layer silhouettes. Foreground: Proscenium arch and curtains at the edges. Negative space: Glowing sky region above the set.
assets.purpose: Structural layout. Use when: Default for verses and choruses.
assets.references: Phase 1 dossier C.3
assets.format: JSON composition spec (slots, focal rect, safe rect, depth, camera), see scene-composition-system.md
assets.dimensions: Resolution independent; normalised 0-1 frame coordinates with per-aspect overrides
assets.layer_structure: ground, far, middle, near set, figures, props, lyric card, proscenium frame. Depth: 5-7 layers with parallax factors.
